questions.q: What is the single work area where nearly all of this course's configuration happens?
options: Setup and Maintenance
The General Ledger journal entry screen
The Reports and Analytics work area
The Oracle Marketplace
questions.explain: Setup and Maintenance is the work area built for configuring Oracle Fusion applications, and it hosts essentially every task in this course.

questions.q: In order from largest to smallest, how does Oracle Fusion organize setup work?
options: Setup task, then functional area, then offering
Offering, then functional area, then setup task
Functional area, then offering, then setup task
There is no consistent organization
questions.explain: The hierarchy runs offering (e.g. Financials) down to functional area (e.g. Enterprise Profile) down to the individual setup task.

questions.q: Which two functional areas does most of this course's work live inside?
options: Fixed Assets and Expenses
Payables Invoicing and Receivables Processing
Enterprise Profile, and Ledger and Reporting Configuration
Order Management and Procurement
questions.explain: Enterprise Profile (legal entities, business units, locations) and Ledger and Reporting Configuration (ledgers, chart of accounts, calendars, currencies) cover nearly everything in this course.

questions.q: What is usually the fastest way to find one specific setup task, once you roughly know its name?
options: Signing out and back in
Contacting Oracle support for every task
Expanding every node in the full offering tree
Typing part of the task name into the search box
questions.explain: The search box surfaces matching tasks regardless of which functional area they technically live in, which is faster than browsing hundreds of tasks.

questions.q: What is an implementation project, in the Setup and Maintenance context?
options: A single journal entry awaiting approval
A named, scoped bundle of setup tasks used to track and manage a specific rollout
A type of chart of accounts segment
A legal entity's registered address
questions.explain: An implementation project groups setup tasks for a specific rollout, lets teams assign owners and track status, and is generated by Functional Setup Manager — covered in Lesson 4.
